title: Minimum Pair Removal to Sort Array I
summary: Given an array nums, repeatedly replace the leftmost adjacent pair with the minimum sum until the array becomes non-decreasing.
statement: Given an array nums, repeatedly replace the leftmost adjacent pair with the minimum sum until the array becomes non-decreasing. The goal is to determine the minimum number of operations required to achieve this.
constraints: While nums is not nondecreasing, find the adjacent pair with minimum sum, choosing the leftmost on ties.
Replace that pair by its sum.
Return the number of operations until the array becomes nondecreasing.
reference_solution:
def minimum_leftmost_pair_removals(nums):
    values=nums[:]
    operations=0
    while any(left>right for left,right in zip(values,values[1:])):
        index=min(range(len(values)-1),key=lambda i:(values[i]+values[i+1],i))
        values[index:index+2]=[values[index]+values[index+1]]
        operations+=1
    return operations
